title: U.S. House · Texas's 16th District
area: El Paso and surrounding El Paso County, in far West Texas.

context.text: Incumbent Veronica Escobar (D) ran unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary. Adam Bauman won the Republican nomination in a May 26, 2026 primary runoff, defeating Manuel Barraza.

candidates.name: Veronica Escobar

positions.summary: Her official site says healthcare is a right every American should enjoy and lists the Medicare for All Act among legislation she supports.
positions.quote: Congresswoman Escobar believes healthcare is a right every American should enjoy

positions.summary: Her official site lists the Women's Health Protection Act, which would create a federal right to access abortion, among legislation she supports.
Her official site calls universal background checks and an assault weapons ban a top priority and lists her cosponsorship of the Assault Weapons Ban of 2025.
positions.quote: Common-sense gun violence prevention, such as requiring universal background checks and banning assault weapons, has been a top priority for Congresswoman Escobar.

positions.summary: Her official site says tax policy should prioritize working families and small businesses rather than billionaires and corporations, and cites her support for the Inflation Reduction Act, which it says holds corporations accountable to pay their fair share of taxes.
positions.quote: Congresswoman Escobar believes tax policies should prioritize working families and small businesses, not billionaires and corporations.

positions.summary: Her official site lists the Raise the Wage Act, which would gradually raise the minimum wage to $17 by 2030, among legislation she supports.
Her official site says she will continue to support a transition to a clean energy future and cites her role in passing the Inflation Reduction Act's clean-energy investments.
positions.quote: I will continue to support our transition to a clean energy future

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Appropriations (Subcommittee on Homeland Security; Subcommittee on Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies) and the Committee on the Budget in the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

candidates.name: Adam Bauman
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 26, 2026 Republican primary runoff over Manuel Barraza.

priorities.text: Lowering El Paso property taxes, which he says are among the highest in Texas.
Supporting Customs and Border Protection's mission to secure the border.
Expanding care and benefits for military veterans.

positions.summary: His campaign website says he is committed to women-only sports, in the wording quoted here.
positions.quote: Biological men have no business competing in women's sports

candidates.researchNotes: Positions and statements from his campaign website. No Candidate Connection survey on file. No birthplace, education, or pre-military details for Bauman were found in public sources.

statements.quote: A secure border is essential for maintaining safety and stability within El Paso.
